evidence.test: the Agent Plugin manifests remain parseable and expose only the portable component roots
the public contract does not advertise unsupported commands or marketplace publication
project identity requires an explicit absolute directory and is stable
entries form a contiguous chain, each committing to its predecessor
admission leases renew, release, expire, and fail closed on resource pressure
renames, deletions, and untracked files remain exact through freeze and delivery
a full route requires plan coverage, both independent reviews, evidence, and arbitration
candidate reads and delivery writes refuse traversal, symlinks, and junctions
a proof cannot touch the repository it is proving against
the parser uses only bundled files and contains no dynamic download path
a second pass reparses nothing when no bytes changed
a delivery is remembered with the gates that justify it
completion takes a request and then an explicit approval
the setup manifest defines five unique, owned, deterministic agents
setup assessment is create, update, noop, or conflict without taking over a user agent
the executor allowlist excludes shell, delegation, governance, and future tools
one native session can serve only one workflow role
reviewers start blind and a missing verdict resumes only its bound session
coordinator preflight fails closed on setup, native tools, and required browser
the package allowlist contains every runtime root and refuses development material
SBOM, license inventory, and notices cover every bundled byte
the release secret scan detects high-confidence credential shapes
the supply-chain verifier uses npm pack and an external tar reader
CI runs the core gate on Windows, macOS, and Linux at the Node floor
